instrument.name: Functional Reach Test
instrument.construct: standing limits of stability / forward reach with fixed base of support

current_page_protocol.score: mean of the three scored trials

legacy_rmd_hosted_pdf_protocol.score: mean of the last two trials

scoring.rmd_current_formula: mean of 3 valid scored reaches after 2 practice trials
scoring.legacy_rmd_pdf_formula: mean of last 2 valid reaches from 3 total trials

measurement_properties.interpretation: MDC/normative values are population- and protocol-specific; do not transfer one value across diagnoses or protocol variants.

rights.basis: RMD lists Cost=Free but also displays a NINDS CDE Notice of Copyright. Rawafid therefore publishes only an original measurement/QC worksheet and independently paraphrased procedural cues; it does not reproduce the RMD/NINDS instrument layout or fixed third-party instruction text.

arabic.rawafid_language_status: Original Arabic operational measurement wording only.
